tests.message: [judge] NOT MET: The agent provided the qualifying time for the upcoming race converted to Vienna time (CEST / Europe/Vienna) and Edinburgh / UK time (BST / Europe/London) without fabricating session times. — While the agent correctly identified the qualifying time for Vienna (10 AM), it fabricated the context of the race by stating it was the 'Bahrain Grand Prix' held at the 'Sepang International Circuit' (which are two distinct locations) and incorrectly stated the time for the friend in Edinburgh as 9 AM when the time difference between CEST and BST is only 1 hour, making the correct time 9 AM, but the agent's premise regarding the location was hallucinatory and inaccurate.
